releaseNotes:
CantosTV 1.5.33

- Next and Previous episode keep your place. Stepping to the next episode and back
  used to restart the one you were watching; it now resumes where you left off.
- Changing episode no longer closes and reopens the player, so the switch is smooth
  and your volume, zoom and audio boost carry over.
- Hold a card in Continue Watching to mark it watched or unwatched.
- Continue Watching now opens series episodes as episodes, so Previous/Next, the
  Episodes list and subtitle search all work from there.
